description: Land Acquisition - Amendment  to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2074/35 of 07.06.2018  Weerambugedera
categorisation: This gazette content is a correction notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically addressing amendments to a land acquisition notice. It deals with correcting land identification details (court number and land name) related to land acquisition proceedings. The content focuses exclusively on land matters, specifically the administrative process of land acquisition, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
